segments.title: Chương 312: 0314 【Luôn có mỹ nữ mới mỗi năm】
segments.content:
Perfect World's listing on NASDAQ went much more smoothly than ByteDance's.

Its inquiry phase even took just one month.

Chen Guiliang had been tormented for over two months, still unsure when the inquiries would end. The company's executives had already entered the later stages and were rehearsing for roadshows, but it was inexplicably delayed again.

This was because Perfect World was a gaming company, and *Perfect World* had already been released in 16 countries and regions worldwide. Its reputation was huge, and its financial reports were impressive.

The story Chi Yufeng told was "Warcraft in the West, Perfect World in the East." During his roadshows, he kept telling American investors that *Perfect World* was the *World of Warcraft* of the East.

With the company's financial reports and distribution regions laid bare, the American investors all believed him!

They scrambled to throw money at Chi Yufeng.

The last time they had dinner and sang karaoke, Chi Yufeng had appeared very composed and serious, but when it came to publicity and marketing, he was a real master.

Back then, before *Perfect World* had even gone online, Chi Yufeng had let netizens "select a consort."

He posted photos of five A-list actresses—International Zhang, Liu Baijie, Liu Tianxian, Zhang Qingcheng, and Li Lianhua—and let netizens vote for the game's spokesperson.

In the end, netizens voted for Liu Tianxian, and he actually hired her for the endorsement.

The entire process cost very little, but the media buzz was explosive, and *Perfect World* quickly broke out of its circle online.

In reality, since *Perfect World* began operating, the popularity of the domestic server had been declining, while the overseas version, on the contrary, was thriving more and more.

"After this video inquiry meeting, they won't pull any more stunts, will they?" Chen Guiliang asked on an overseas call.

Lu Zhihui said, "I'm asking Goldman Sachs to help, but they can't interfere directly. Anyway, the process is very troublesome. They keep questioning endlessly because they themselves are not sure. I estimate it will be delayed for another month at most, and we'll definitely pass the review."

"Then I'm heading to Magic City," Chen Guiliang said.

This year, the scale of the summer ChinaJoy digital exhibition in Magic City was exceptionally large.

Especially the cosplay competition at the exhibition, which began its general mobilization several months in advance. It was even divided into several competition zones, letting netizens vote, making it just like a Super Girl audition.

This year, Youke was bringing several games over.

*Sanguosha* was, of course, a fixture.

*Plants vs. Zombies* had already been updated to Chapter Two, and the online ranking feature had also been improved.

*Seven Nights* had just won an award, and Youke and Dingguo Technology had set up a joint booth.

*Future Era* was about to open for registration, with a maximum character level of 45. This was the top priority for this year's promotion.

There were also a few other casual mini-games.

The scale of Youke's booth was getting bigger and bigger.

Chen Guiliang sat in the departure lounge, surrounded by Youke employees. From time to time, passersby would walk past, their gazes always lingering on Xu Fengyin and Ding Beili for a few seconds.

The phone rang.

As soon as he answered, Shi Yuzhu asked, "Are you personally going to the CJ exhibition this year?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Already waiting for the flight."

Shi Yuzhu grumbled, "Damn it, Perfect World went public without a peep. Chi Yufeng is also on a flight back to China. That son of a bitch is even going to CJ to show off!"

Chen Guiliang laughed, "You can go public too, don't indulge him."

Shi Yuzhu thought to himself: I'm about to go public. Financial compliance is done, and I'm currently submitting the registration statement.

At this year's CJ digital exhibition, the one stealing the show was actually The9's Zhu Jun.

The9 brought several games at once, and players could even try out *World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade* on the spot. This expansion pack had been out for half a year, but the domestic server had yet to be updated. It was only playable at the CJ exhibition.

As a result, The9's booth was almost mobbed, densely packed with people queuing up to play Warcraft.

After chatting nonsense with Shi Yuzhu for a bit, Chen Guiliang had just hung up when Tao Chenggang called, asking which hotel Chen Guiliang had booked.

Before boarding, the calls came one after another.

Even Ning Hao called, "Mr. Chen, filming for *Silver Medal Driver* is about to start. Do you have time to make a cameo?"

"Where's the shoot?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Ning Hao replied, "Xiamen."

Chen Guiliang said, "I probably don't have time."

Ning Hao added, "If Mr. Chen wants to make a cameo, I can write in a scene just for you."

"We'll see. I've been quite busy lately," Chen Guiliang said.

*Silver Medal Driver* was *Crazy Racer*. The film's name kept changing, as did the script and cast.

Preparations had already begun last year, and Chen Guiliang had invested 1 million RMB.

It was his personal investment, because ByteDance's funds were a bit tight, and Game Science was not investing in film and television for the time being.

Since Huang Bo was busy filming and couldn't get away, *Crazy Racer* had to find another actor for the male lead.

The initial choice was settled: Nicholas Zhao Si!

He was recommended by Uncle Benshan, who even treated Ning Hao to a meal. His fee was 500,000 RMB.

But halfway through, Zhao Si demanded a 200,000 RMB raise, which thoroughly disgusted Ning Hao. Including Chen Guiliang's 1 million investment, the film's total budget was only 11 million RMB.

Ning Hao didn't give Uncle Benshan any face either, shelving the filming plan to look for a new leading actor. After a delay, it was a good opportunity to revise the script.

At this time, Huang Bo finished his filming ahead of schedule and was available, so the male lead was once again set as Huang Bo. Moreover, Huang Bo only asked for a fee of 300,000 RMB.

Chen Guiliang boarded the plane, and Guan Zhiqiang called again.

"Huo huo huo huo huo... Great Hero Chen, I'm going to Xiamen to be in a movie!" Guan Zhiqiang was extremely excited.

Chen Guiliang was speechless, "For a small cameo role, you're really flying to Xiamen? Your pay won't even cover the plane ticket."

Guan Zhiqiang said, "I'm not in it for the money. Besides, Director Ning said I have two lines, not like in *Crazy Stone* where I only showed my face."

Chen Guiliang asked, "What's your role?"

Guan Zhiqiang said, "Still a security guard. One line is 'He ran that way,' and the other is 'Stop him!'"

"Hahahaha!"

Chen Guiliang burst out laughing.

A flight attendant came over to remind him to turn off his phone, and only then did Chen Guiliang hang up.

The plane took off. He closed his eyes to rest, and as he did, he fell asleep.

When he woke up, the plane was landing.

At this year's CJ digital exhibition, the competition among the showgirls was even more insane.

Any game company with even a little capability would start scouting for beautiful women two or three months in advance. Because beauties had gone viral in previous years, they could bring huge attention to the games.

In '04 it was Sun Ting, in '05 it was Xu Fengyin, in '06 it was Ding Beili, and this year there would surely be some new star making a name for herself.

Netizens were always fickle, and the three from previous years were no longer fresh. It had to be a newcomer to generate more buzz.

The organizers also catered to the public's sentiment and started a showgirl selection contest, with rankings and awards decided by online voting.

As soon as the digital exhibition began, many old pervs were already wandering around with cameras in hand.

On just the first morning of the exhibition, the old pervs had already scouted out a beauty.

This beauty was named Zhu Hong, hired by Sohu to cosplay as A Zhu from *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils*. She completely stole the thunder from the one cosplaying Wang Yuyan.

Someone even took out a laptop, squatted on the ground on the spot, and used the wireless network to upload Zhu Hong's photos to forums and Tieba.

The crowd gathering to watch the beautiful A Zhu grew larger and larger, and in no time, even a fan moniker was decided: Hongxin—Zhu Hong's loyal supporters.

Youke's booth was not far from Sohu's, and Chen Guiliang looked over there with disdain.

Damn it, Sohu was definitely behind this organization. Otherwise, it would be impossible to create such a huge scene on the first day.

It seemed Zhang Chaoyang's time in the entertainment industry wasn't for nothing; he was getting more and more skilled at hyping things up.

Zhu Hong herself was also quite good at self-promotion.

Every year, she would participate in various events, working as a showgirl or cosplayer for games everywhere. Next year, she would even go on *My Show* and make it to the top 30.
